sections.title: What is the KP System?
sections.body: The Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) system was developed by K.S. Krishnamurti. Unlike traditional Vedic astrology that often gives broad windows, KP uses Sub-Lord theory — dividing each star into finer segments — to pinpoint when events are most likely to unfold. KP indicates favorable periods and tendencies; it does not guarantee outcomes.

sections.title: Career & Education
sections.body: Guidance for course selection, job predictions, promotion timing, government vs private roles, foreign career, and competitive exams — using the 4th, 6th, 9th, 10th, and 11th houses.

sections.title: Marriage & Relationships
sections.body: Kundali matching, marriage timing, delayed marriage analysis, post-marriage issues, and Kuja Dosha assessment using the 7th cusp Sub-Lord.

sections.title: Finance & Business
sections.body: Property timing, financial pattern analysis, loan clearance windows, inheritance, and investment periods via the 2nd, 4th, 8th, and 11th houses.

sections.title: Health
sections.body: Health pattern insights and surgery timing using the 1st, 6th, 8th, and 12th houses — always as a complement to medical care, never a replacement.

sections.title: Childbirth & Muhurtham
sections.body: Progeny analysis, conception windows, C-section muhurtham, and auspicious timing for marriage, Gruha Pravesham, business opening, and ceremonies.

sections.title: Prashna (Horary)
sections.body: Instant Yes/No answers using the KP 1–249 number system — no birth details required. Ideal for lost items, exam outcomes, interview results, and urgent decisions.
